title: Hex wargaming: stacking, terrain costs, CRT combat
description: Feature track for hex wargaming support. Foundation data model (stacking, orientation) is implemented directly. Complex mechanics go to WASM: combat resolution tables (CRT), supply line connectivity, terrain-aware movement point costs. This epic covers the gap between the current grid-game engine and hex wargaming requirements. Sub-issues handle individual mechanics.
close_reason: Ogre proved hex wargaming mechanics: stacking, terrain movement costs, CRT combat, subsystem targeting. Remaining WASM generalizations (baize-0d6, baize-1w4, baize-el1) are independent engine features, not blockers.
